info.title: SecurePay rules API
info.description:
Creates, changes, enables and disables the antifraud rules of the decision engine. Every change is a new catalog version, stored in PostgreSQL and never modified, and published to Valkey, where the engine picks it up in about a second without a restart.

Send `X-User` with your name: it is the author of the version (`anonymous` when missing).

post.summary: Simulate a catalog over one day of the history
post.description: Replays the transactions of `day` (and the day before, so the 24-hour history starts full) with the engine's own rules, once with `candidate` and once with the current catalog (or `against_version`), and compares them: decisions, cases, the rule metrics against the labels, how many transactions change and how much money the candidate would let through (`released_usd`). `candidate` is a whole catalog or its list of rules. Nothing is written: no rule, no catalog version, nothing published to Valkey. One day at a time (D5): a range gives 422. The transactions come from the lake's `raw/decisiones` (`ANALYTICS_DATA_DIR`); device and password changes are not there, so `account_takeover` does not fire in a simulation.

CatalogSnapshot.title: CatalogSnapshot
CatalogSnapshot.description: The whole catalog at one version. Immutable once published.

published.title: Published
published.description: True when Valkey now holds this version.

catalog_version.title: Catalog Version
catalog_version.description: Catalog version after the request. The same as before when nothing changed.

code.title: Code
code.description: Name in rules_triggered: English snake_case, 3 to 50 characters.

type.title: Type
type.description: Which implementation runs it. Several rules can share a type with other params.

rn.title: Rn
rn.description: Business rule it implements, e.g. RN-02.

score.title: Score
score.description: Adds to risk_score when the rule fires.

params.title: Params
params.description: Thresholds, validated against the rule type.

RuleCreate.title: RuleCreate
RuleCreate.description: A new rule. It always starts at rule_version 1.

RuleEntry.title: RuleEntry
RuleEntry.description:
One rule of the catalog: which implementation (type) runs, with
which parameters, and what it decides when it fires.

RuleUpdate.title: RuleUpdate
RuleUpdate.description:
Replaces what a rule decides and its thresholds. The code and the
type never change: create another rule instead.

released_usd.title: Released Usd
released_usd.description: USD the candidate approves that the current catalog held or rejected.

stopped_usd.title: Stopped Usd
stopped_usd.description: USD the candidate holds or rejects that the current catalog approved.

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: Up to 10 transactions that change, largest amount first.

day.title: Day
day.description: The day replayed (UTC). One day at a time (D5).

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: The catalog to try: a whole CatalogSnapshot or its list of rules.

against_version.title: Against Version
against_version.description: Catalog version to compare with; the latest when missing.

SimulationRequest.title: SimulationRequest
SimulationRequest.description: A candidate catalog replayed over one day of the history (HU-24).

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: APPROVE, HOLD and REJECT of the day.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: rule_metrics against the labels of the lake (HU-44).

change.title: Change
change.description: {"operation", "code", "before", "after"}; before and after are the whole rule.
